report:
Vulva, right labium minus, local excision

Received in formalin is a local excision specimen of vulva measuring 30 x 18 x 6 mm. The specimen is orientated: suture at 12 o'clock. There is an ulcerated tumour on the right labium minus measuring 12 x 9 mm, 5 mm from the closest (medial) margin. The margins are inked. Representative sections are taken in 10 blocks.

(1-4) Tumour with deep margin.
(5-8) Peripheral margins, 12 to 9 o'clock.
(9-10) Adjacent skin.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Local excision
- Tumour site: Right labium minus
- Tumour size: 12 mm (greatest dimension)
- Tumour focality: Unifocal

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, HPV-associated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is an HPV-associated squamous cell carcinoma with a basaloid pattern, invading to a depth of 0.8 mm. Infiltrating nests and sheets of basaloid squamous cells with scant cytoplasm and hyperchromatic nuclei lie in a desmoplastic stroma, with little keratinisation. On immunohistochemistry, p16 shows diffuse block-type staining and p53 shows a wild-type pattern.
- Depth of invasion: 0.8 mm (conventional method: 1.2 mm)
- Tumour border: Infiltrating
- Other tissue / organ involvement: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Invasive carcinoma, peripheral margin: Uninvolved (closest 4 mm, medial)
- Invasive carcinoma, deep margin: Uninvolved (closest 3 mm)
- Squamous precursor lesion (HSIL): Involved (lateral)

Pathological stage (AJCC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT1a

Additional findings
- Adjacent epithelium: HSIL (VIN 3)

HPV testing
- HPV PCR: High-risk HPV detected (HPV 16)

VULVA, right labium minus, local excision
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, HPV-ASSOCIATED, 12 mm, invading to a depth of 0.8 mm;
  completely excised (closest margin 3 mm, deep); HSIL present at the margin
  (lateral); see synoptic report
- pT1a (AJCC 9th edition)
- Background HSIL (VIN 3)

Depth of invasion is measured by the FIGO 2021 method.
